title: A Stray in a Manger
start: Speak to the snow imp near the Draynor lodestone.

rewards.t: Gift of Giving, which gives one of a number of possible items. The Gift of Giving may be traded with other players to receive more items. This includes:
Players will earn the title once all the kennel customisations are unlocked
Named snow implings, which can be handed in for up to 200,000 Bonus Hunter Experience (see below).

Stocking Fillers - miscellaneous objects, such as holy biscuits, roast potatoes, monkey nuts, fireworks, confetti, firecrackers, Christmas pudding, and snowballs. Receiving these items signals the end of the unique items. (Note: Players don't have to obtain all main rewards before receiving these objects.) Free players can also get purple sweets, mulled wine, yule log, turkey drumstick, charcoal, or an orange, which are members-only items. You can also receive a bubble maker.

steps.t:
• The doberman can be found to the south, near The Skulls Headquarters, which is an old jail block. You will find the dog north of the jail outside the yard.
• The dalmatian can be found wandering around the Al Kharid Bazaar.
• The labrador can be found near the bridge to the White Knights' Castle in Falador.
• The mongrel can be found in Varrock near Aubury's rune shop or the Blue Moon Inn.

After finding all the dogs, return to the Snow imp. He will give the dogs names. The Dalmatian is named Little 'Elper. The Doberman is named Oddie, after a scientist near Draynor. The Labrador is named Sir Chen Rescoo, because he is from Falador, home of the White Knights. The Mongrel is named Patch.

Soon after, he will whisper that they are Dragon's belly, meaning smelly. He would then like you to clean them and gives you a bucket of water for that purpose. Clean the four dogs and return to the Snow Imp. The dogs will then become reindeer for his sleigh and a cutscene will play. After a few moments, he will have the presents magically delivered and eating mince snowballs that the pets left for him.

p: Pet Santa gives you your present.
